Thông tin cần có: Child age and operator policy.
Trạng thái trong thư viện: Checking Supplier
Lưu ý khi dùng: Never assume one child policy applies to all suppliers.

Dear Mr./Ms. [Guest Name],
Child pricing varies by tour operator and age category. Please share the child’s age on the travel date, and we will check the exact rate and included services.

templates.title: N19 3 Ghế trẻ em trên xe
lines: Mẫu trong thư viện Notion  |  Nguồn S4 mục 19.3
Tình huống gốc: Guest requests a child seat.
Thông tin cần có: Child age, approximate height/weight if supplier requires, vehicle.
Trạng thái trong thư viện: Checking Supplier

Dear Mr./Ms. [Guest Name],
We will check child-seat availability with the transport provider. Please share the child’s age and any sizing information requested by the provider. The seat is confirmed only after the provider accepts the request.

templates.title: N20 1 Khách hỏi độ an toàn của tour
lines: Mẫu trong thư viện Notion  |  Nguồn S4 mục 20.1
Tình huống gốc: Guest asks about safety.
Thông tin cần có: Tour, supplier credentials available, current conditions.
Trạng thái trong thư viện: Need Review
Lưu ý khi dùng: Avoid absolute statements such as completely safe or guaranteed safety.

Dear Mr./Ms. [Guest Name],
We work with selected tour operators and will provide the confirmed transport, guide and activity information available for [Tour Name]. Please tell us if you have any specific safety concerns so we can verify them directly with the operator before booking.

templates.title: N20 2 Khách hỏi an toàn xe và tài xế
lines: Mẫu trong thư viện Notion  |  Nguồn S4 mục 20.2
Tình huống gốc: Guest asks about the vehicle or driver.
Thông tin cần có: Provider, vehicle type and verified operating information.
Trạng thái trong thư viện: Checking Supplier
Lưu ý khi dùng: Use only verified supplier facts.

Dear Mr./Ms. [Guest Name],
We will confirm the vehicle type, driver arrangement and applicable provider information for your service. If you have a specific concern, please let us know and we will check it before confirmation.

templates.title: N21 1 Phương thức thanh toán khách sạn
lines: Mẫu trong thư viện Notion  |  Nguồn S4 mục 21.1
Tình huống gốc: Guest asks how to pay the hotel.
Thông tin cần có: Current hotel payment policy.
Trạng thái trong thư viện: Approved
Lưu ý khi dùng: Keep this separate from tour-operator payment rules.

Dear Mr./Ms. [Guest Name],
Cash payment is accepted without an additional charge. Credit card payment is available with a 5% service fee.

templates.title: N21 2 Thời điểm thanh toán tour
lines: Mẫu trong thư viện Notion  |  Nguồn S4 mục 21.2
Tình huống gốc: Guest asks when to pay.
Thông tin cần có: Supplier-specific deposit and balance policy.
Trạng thái trong thư viện: Checking Supplier

Dear Mr./Ms. [Guest Name],
Payment conditions vary by tour. Some operators allow payment upon pickup, while others require a deposit or full advance payment. We will confirm the exact amount, deadline, payment method and cancellation terms for your selected tour.

templates.title: N21 3 Hóa đơn VAT khách sạn
lines: Mẫu trong thư viện Notion  |  Nguồn S4 mục 21.3
Tình huống gốc: Guest asks for a hotel VAT invoice.
Thông tin cần có: Company name, address, tax code, invoice email and legal deadline.
Trạng thái trong thư viện: Need Review

Dear Mr./Ms. [Guest Name],
We can prepare a VAT invoice for eligible hotel charges. Please provide the company name, company address, tax code and invoice email. Our team will confirm the invoice details and applicable issuance requirements.

templates.title: N21 4 Hóa đơn của nhà cung cấp tour
lines: Mẫu trong thư viện Notion  |  Nguồn S4 mục 21.4
Tình huống gốc: Guest requests an invoice for a tour.
Thông tin cần có: Tour, operator, booking reference, invoice availability.
Trạng thái trong thư viện: Checking Supplier
Lưu ý khi dùng: Do not promise that the hotel can issue the operator’s invoice.

Dear Mr./Ms. [Guest Name],
We will ask the tour operator whether an invoice can be issued for your booking and what company information is required. We will update you after the operator confirms.

Tình huống gốc: VIP or high-value guest before arrival.
Thông tin cần có: Guest preferences already known, stay dates.
Trạng thái trong thư viện: New Inquiry
Lưu ý khi dùng: Do not promise every request can be fulfilled.

Dear Mr./Ms. [Guest Name],
We are honored to welcome you to Luxe Paradise Premium Hotel. If you have any preferences regarding transportation, room setup, dining or tours, please feel free to share them. Our team will review the arrangements and confirm what can be prepared for your stay.
